notes.text: Site manager (Bauleiter) on the Wohnanlage Lichtenberg project for Becker Bau. Reports to Frau Brandt.
Work on site starts at 7:00. Toolbox talk on Mondays.
Safety shoes and a hard hat are mandatory on site at all times.
The foreman is Ahmed Yilmaz. Electrical subcontractor is Elektro Schulz.
The weekly report goes to Frau Brandt on Friday by noon.
Lena is 8 and in second grade at the Grundschule am Fennpfuhl.
Felix is 5 and goes to Kita Sonnenschein until 16:30.
Felix has his recorder lesson on Wednesdays.
Lena swims on Tuesdays at 16:30.
Maya's mother Ingrid takes the kids on Sundays.
Karlshorster FC, Alte Herren. Training on Tuesdays at 20:00, matches on Sundays.
Coach is Marcel. I play right back.
The membership fee is 120 euros a year.
Skoda Octavia Kombi, 2019, diesel. Serviced at Autohaus Nowak.
Car insurance is with HUK and renews on 30 November.
We rent the flat in Lichtenberg. The landlord is Herr Lange and repairs go through the Hausverwaltung.
The kids' room is the small one facing the courtyard.
The tax advisor is Frau Okonkwo. Tax class is IV.
Receipts go in the blue folder until they are scanned.
Race bike is a 2021 Canyon Endurace in size L. The commuter is an old Kreidler.
The commute to the site is about 14 km each way.
Default thread for errands, shopping and anything that does not fit elsewhere.
Oma lives in Hamburg and her birthday is on 14 November.
Home pitch is the Sportplatz Karlshorst.
Deadline for the tax return with an advisor is the end of July.

memories.text: They live in Berlin with their wife Maya and their kids Lena and Felix.
They are a site manager at Becker Bau and started there in October 2026.
Their wife is Maya.
Their daughter Lena is 8 and their son Felix is 5.
They drive a Skoda Octavia Kombi.
They play football for Karlshorster FC.
They cycle to work when it is dry.
Their boss at Becker Bau is Frau Brandt, the Projektleiterin.
Their mother-in-law is Ingrid.
They go by Tom.
They write in a mix of German and English.
They have a tax advisor, Frau Okonkwo.
They rent a flat in Lichtenberg, Berlin.
Their brother is Alex.
Their previous employer was Meier Hochbau.
The foreman on their site is Ahmed.
They ride a Canyon road bike.
They support Union Berlin.
Their mother lives in Hamburg.
Their wedding anniversary is 9 December.
